text:
zoe: Quick sync: Partner announcement with Nimbus Cloud slipped into their roadmap. They want a co-ordinated blurb pushed the same hour as our launch. Can we accommodate? Need PR + blog schedule implications.

peter: If we align, we need to tighten the launch timeline by 30 minutes so both posts go live in the same hour. Is legal OK with joint wording?

ana: (cc: ana) Product note: partner integration is on GA for dedicated tier, but private deployments are "coming soon". We should be explicit to avoid support tickets.

ana: Proposed partner blurb for press kit: "In partnership with Nimbus Cloud, Redwood Inference delivers turnkey inference on private cloud deployments for enterprise customers."

legal: Quick flag: change "turnkey" to "integrated" and avoid implying Broad support beyond stated platforms. Also we need Nimbus sign-off on any co-branded assets.

ana: Edited blurb: "In partnership with Nimbus Cloud, Redwood Inference offers integrated private cloud deployment options for enterprise customers."

carl: PR ops: If we go live same hour, we'll need final CEO quote + one-line partner quote by 5pm PT today so I can prep the co-release. Also confirm embargo or live release?

zoe: Nimbus prefers live release (no embargo) but will hold internal comms until we say go. That means we have to publish at scheduled time and PR will ping Nimbus to post.

peter: Does that break the plan for TechCrunch outreach? We had a 24-hour embargo list for targeted outlets.

carl: It would. Option A: keep our embargo and ask Nimbus to delay. Option B: go live now and notify embargoed outlets that the partner released a public post (they may still run). Recommend A to keep control.

press-bot: Nimbus comms team reached out: "We can delay until your signal if needed."

zoe: Great, so we keep the embargo. Nimbus will wait. Now logistics: final CEO quotes please. Two variants: 1-line for press release, 2-line for partner release.

ana: Draft CEO 1-line: "Redwood Inference gives engineering teams predictable inference performance and enterprise deployment choices."

peter: Shorten to be punchier: "Making predictable, production-grade LLM inference available to engineering teams."

carl: Social copy needed for Nimbus cross-post: short + alt longer LinkedIn. Drop both here.

zoe: Cross-post drafts:
- short: "Partnering with @NimbusCloud to bring private cloud inference to enterprise teams. Learn more: <link>"
- long: "Today were announcing a partnership with Nimbus Cloud to make private cloud LLM inference easier for organizations that need control and compliance. Read more: <link>"

legal: Replace @mention with full company name in press release. Also add approved privacy/security line: "Does not retain customer prompt contents beyond transient inference caches; supports customer-managed KMS integrations."

ana: Adding the security line to all public copy. Also product asks we call out Dedicated GA where applicable.

carl: PR checklist updated: final CEO quote, partner quote, press kit link, security blurb, approved hero image, embargo list, and press contact list. I need all items in this thread by 5pm PT.

press-bot: Uploaded hero image variant "hero-nimbus-co-brand.png" to /press-kit/assets.

zoe: Design note: please ensure Nimbus logo is the approved partner asset. @press-bot can you confirm the partner signed the co-brand logo?

press-bot: Confirmed: Nimbus legal signed co-brand asset at 2025-06-02T14:05Z.

carl: OK timeline: 17:00 PT today final copy lock, 09:00 PT release day embargo lift. peter, you'll send embargo list at 17:05 with assets attached?

peter: Yes. Will attach final press kit and bench appendix. Tom (eng) will we have the benchmark readme ready?

ana: Tom is OOO today; I have the benchmark readme but want to note we only validated on the Dedicated GA config. Add a line in the readme clarifying test environment.

legal: Last check: remove any comparative language like "better than" or "faster than" unless backed by head-to-head tests. Use "up to" phrasing for throughput.

zoe: Final editorial items: replace any comparative language, include security blurb, and mark benchmarks as Dedicated-GA results. Everyone drop approvals here by 5pm PT.

carl: I'll schedule the embargo email and prepare the PR distribution. deploy-bot: create calendar for quick pre-launch call 08:30 PT on release day.

deploy-bot: Created event "Pre-launch sync: Press & Partner" for 2025-06-10 08:30 PT. Invitees: zoe, peter, ana, carl, legal.

peter: Sending embargo list at 17:05 PT. Final CEO 1-line confirmed: "Making predictable, production-grade LLM inference available to engineering teams."

zoe: Thanks all. We'll reconvene in the pre-launch call for final publish step. :sparkles:
